neighbours.label: Preposition (' for', ' by', ' in') right after a tie/link verb, especially 'tied for' a rank in sports results
fire: After the first round, the young golfer is two shots off the lead and tied for third.
The women tied for seventh in the conference standings with a record of ten wins.
A junior forward led the team in goals and tied for fourth in the league.
The two heroines discover that they are linked by a supernatural destiny that gives them powers.
Both sophomores tied for second overall after the final event of the weekend meet.
The rookie finished tied for fifth in the tournament despite a poor start.
Their families are bound by an old secret that nobody in town ever mentions aloud.
The runners tied in the final heat, and judges needed a photo to separate them.
quiet: Two shots off the lead, the young golfer is smiling after the first round.
Seventh in the conference standings, the women finished with a record of ten wins.
Leading the team in goals, a junior forward ranked fourth in the league.
Supernatural powers are shared by the two heroines in this strange new story.
Second overall after the final event of the weekend meet were both sophomores.
Despite a poor start, the rookie finished fifth in the tournament.
He waited for the bus while the rain fell on the empty street by the station.
Judges prepared the stopwatch as the runners lined up for the final heat.

notes: Label and sentences written by Claude Sonnet subagents (8 poles each) from the card text alone (prompt: haiku_labeler/prompt_l5.md); one retry on mechanical checks. Part of a 192-pole layer-5 sweep.
